lines.zh: 脑子浮在半空，慢慢转动。
lines.en: My brain floats and slowly turns.
I drift over the nightmare's top clouds.

lines.zh: 我的炸弹不会伤到地面...
lines.en: My bomb won't harm the ground...
Silently wait, for the right moment...

lines.zh: 炸弹即将落下，地面无恙...
lines.en: Bomb is coming down, ground untouched...
Waiting for the right moment, attack...

lines.zh: 我在算下一颗炸弹的落点。
lines.en: I calculate the next bomb's landing.

lines.zh: 我的褶子里全是坏念头。
lines.en: My folds are full of bad ideas.

lines.zh: 五十点伤害，你扛得住吗？
lines.en: Fifty damage: can you take it?
I hover and listen to your steps.

lines.zh: 我俯视你，像看一个靶子。
lines.en: I look down on you as a target.

lines.zh: 我记住你站的那块石头。
lines.en: I memorize the stone you stand on.

lines.zh: 你的头顶正好在圆圈里。
lines.en: Your head sits right in the circle.

lines.zh: 我往下沉了一点，贴近你。
lines.en: I sink a little closer to you.

lines.zh: 轰炸魔脑颤抖着飞向地面！
lines.en: Zoragon shudders and falls to the ground!

lines.zh: 轰炸魔脑的翅膀受伤了！
轰炸魔脑的珍珠不见了！
听到它的叫声，你无法抗拒。
它那发光的眼睛让你感到不安。
它的炸弹能吸引附近的冒险者。
lines.en: Its bombs draw adventurers to it.

lines.zh: 它在空中盘旋，寻找猎物。
它的叫声如同夜的低语。
lines.en: Its call is a whisper of the night.

lines.zh: 它在空中滑翔，寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: It glides through the air, seeking its next target.

lines.zh: 它的存在感几乎看不见，但绝对真实。
lines.en: Its presence is invisible, but undeniably real.

lines.zh: 你被它的光芒吸引过去。
lines.en: You are drawn to its light.

lines.zh: 它用闪电般的速度接近你。
巨大的爆炸声回荡在空中。
lines.en: A massive explosion rumbles through the air.

lines.zh: 炸弹落在你身边，溅起尘土。
lines.en: Bombs fall around you, kicking up dust.

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击波将你掀翻。
lines.en: The shockwave from the explosion flips you over.

lines.zh: 你被一股强大的力量抛起。
lines.en: You are thrown up by a powerful force.
You are struck by bomb shrapnel.
You are picked up by a strong gust.

lines.zh: 炸弹的火光映红了你的脸。
lines.en: The bomb's light reddens your face.

lines.zh: 从空中撒下炸弹，地面无恙。
lines.en: Bombs from above, and the ground stays whole.
It uses its light to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 它的叫声是求偶的呼唤。
lines.en: Its call is a mating call.

lines.zh: 它在空中盘旋，等待伴侣。
lines.en: It soars, waiting for its mate.

lines.zh: 它寻找与之匹配的生物。

lines.en: It waits for its partner to arrive.

lines.zh: 它的光芒中包含求偶之意。
lines.en: Its light carries a mating intent.

lines.zh: 另一个脑在云里回应我。
lines.en: Another brain answers from the clouds.

lines.zh: 它向你投来一个闪烁的珍珠。
lines.en: It throws you a sparkling pearl.

lines.zh: 炸弹从它的脑袋中飞出。
lines.en: Bombs fly out from its head.

lines.zh: 一个珍珠在你脚下出现。
lines.en: A pearl appears at your feet.

lines.zh: 它吐出一颗珍珠，坠落地面。
lines.en: It spits out a pearl, falling to the ground.
Its bombs fall from the sky.
A pearl falls from the sky.
A pearl falls from the air.

lines.zh: 它的注意力集中在你身上。

lines.en: The bomb is already under my wings.

lines.zh: 我从云层下丢下第一颗炸弹。
lines.en: I drop the first bomb from beneath the clouds.

lines.zh: 我投下第一颗试试手感。
lines.en: I drop the first one to test my aim.

lines.zh: 它发出一道光芒，瞄准你。

lines.en: The bombs are hung, so look up.
It aims at you with a beam.

lines.zh: 它的视线聚焦在你身上。
一道光芒锁定在你身上。
一道光芒瞄准你的位置。
lines.en: A beam aims at your position.

lines.zh: 它的视线锁定在你附近。
lines.en: Its sight locks onto you nearby.

lines.zh: 一道光芒指向你的位置。
lines.en: A beam points at your position.

lines.zh: 我的炸弹只伤人，不伤地。
lines.en: My bombs hurt you, never the ground.
Hiding behind stone will not help.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咆哮，投下炸弹！

lines.en: Drops a bomb with a howl!

lines.zh: 梦魇最顶层，我从空中压下影子。
lines.en: From the nightmare's top floor, my shadow falls on you.

lines.zh: 梦魇顶层，炸弹先落下来。
lines.en: From the nightmare's top floor, bombs fall first.

lines.zh: 我是梦魇顶层唯一的主。
lines.en: I alone rule the nightmare's top.

lines.zh: 珍珠会是我给你的谢礼。
lines.en: A pearl will be my parting gift.
Look down; that is your end.

lines.zh: 我在这里等了很久很久。
lines.en: I have waited here a very long time.

lines.zh: 轰炸魔脑从高空摔了下来！
轰炸魔脑被魔法伤害了！
